_comment: One rule exists per worker node (e.g. 'RAM > 85% — worker1', 'RAM > 85% — worker2'). Template below — duplicate per node and substitute <NODE_TAILSCALE_IP> and <NODE_NAME>. IMPORTANT: this rule shipped with two separate bugs on both node copies (see docs/incident-reports/04-alerting-audit.md) — one multiplied by *0 instead of *100 (always evaluated to zero, could never fire), the other was missing the *100 operator entirely (PromQL syntax error, silently never evaluated). The corrected expression is shown below.
title: RAM > 85% — <NODE_NAME>
